title: Revert scope response
description: Owner decision RS-2 (basalt_meta version 21). The 200 answer to POST /api/v1/reverts/{revertId}/scope: the rebuilt revert request and, only for a proven widen or a narrow under its scope token, the catalog the person picks from. No other route, function or view returns the catalog. See CONTRACT.md, Revert, Rescope, widen and reject.

request.description: The revert request for the new select: new binding (rowsHash, expiresAt), its lines, a new rescopeNonce after a widen. The page checks it as any revert request.

catalog.description: What the person may choose from inside the widest select they proved: the agents with changes in it, their runs, the tables written, and from basalt_meta version 32 the agent of each change. Present only on a proven widen and on a narrow under its token; every other answer, and every view or tool the requesting agent reads, has no catalog and so no changeAgents.

changes.description: Its applied or reverted changes that wrote rows in the scope.

rows.description: Rows written in the scope by the agents shown.

additionalProperties.description: The agent role that made the change.

changeAgents.description: basalt_meta version 32 (owner decision Q-11): every change in the widest select the person proved, by change id, to the agent role that made it. It covers every change id the request's lines name, so the page tags each row with its agents. Absent on a guard older than version 32; the page then tags rows only when the select names exactly one agent.
